last_episode_to_air.name: ECW Hardcore TV - Dec. 30, 2000
last_episode_to_air.overview: While Danny Doring and Roadkill defend their Tag Team Championships against Da Baldies, Nova and Balls Mahoney battle Hot Commodity to become the new number one contenders. Cyrus orders Christian York to faceoff with Jerry Lynn in the main event. All this and more!
